items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Beewee Robinson as a piano player who played with 'him' (Jimmy Robinson) for twenty-two years; Interviewee Sam Jones does not respond or claim a personal connection.

ctx.x: And uh, and then he began to say take my car to the next gig. And give us some money. And this is something, man, he--out of twenty something years, he had a piano player playing with him--played with him for twenty-two years, man. Beewee Robinson. [Jimmy Robinson]
